implementation_summary: No code change. The DEC-009 / D-010 pnpm override '@grpc/grpc-js': '>=1.13.6' in pnpm-workspace.yaml, applied by the coordinator, clears the advisory. firebase stays pinned exactly in packages/wizard/package.json. No firebase version carries a patched grpc-js (every @firebase/firestore pins ~1.9.0), so the override is the fix. I verified audit, tests, type-check and the firebase import surface.
risks: The grpc-js override rests on firestore being unused by the wizard. The wizard code imports only firebase/app and firebase/auth.
